selection.decision: At every actor action opportunity select the highest-priority legal ready skill; auto-attacks are filler and cannot starve ready skills.
selection.priorityMode: setup then descending raw damage; ties by skill number
selection.autoAttackDualWeapons: One combined action using already combined character physicalAttack; never count offhand as a second attack.

notes: Both canonical weapon variants remain separate output rows.
Shared Body Control applies 3 percent mana reduction.
Energy Discharge uses legacy dmgType Physicas but is a valid attack.
Zorn des Henkers +100 critical rating is ignored because rating-to-chance is undefined and random criticals are excluded.
No optional self buffs Kampfinstinkt, Geist des Kriegers, Blutrausch or Bis in den Tod.
No low-health trigger passives expected on a harmless target unless self health costs actually meet their thresholds; random triggers excluded.
Energy of Anger is a necessary setup exception, refresh only when absent and ready.
Starting with 100 rage is not permission to refill rage whenever Outburst cooldown expires.
At each dependent cast require the actual Outburst strength buff and sufficient remaining rage.
The complete rage quartet spends 100 total, but a cooldown-ready repeat may be legal during the 64-second buff if rage was rebuilt.
No outgoing refund on Sturm der Wut; older catalog previously granted 5 rage and must not be reused.
Optional Provoke is excluded; if threat shown label damage-only or separate hypothetical multiplier.
